title: Fabric Supersat project settings
description: Local settings in .fabric-supersat/settings.yaml. Yours only: the folder is ignored by git.

workspace.description: Fabric workspace that commands work in. Change it with "Fabric Supersat: Select Workspace".

id.description: Workspace ID (a GUID), as shown in the workspace URL: app.fabric.microsoft.com/groups/<id>. Empty when none is selected.

name.description: Workspace display name, shown in the status bar. Informational: the ID decides which workspace is used.
